prompt: Here is the requirement: Users can export the invoice list as CSV. The export contains the columns the user currently sees. Write the acceptance criteria, estimate the story points and tell me which one to build first.
output:
This skill does not design screens, rewrite copy, estimate or prioritise.

## Acceptance criteria: export the invoice list as CSV

Requirement: Users can export the invoice list as a CSV file that holds the columns they can see at that moment.

### Main path
AC-1. Given a user viewing the invoice list, when the user exports the invoice list, then the user receives the invoice list as a CSV file. _Users can export the invoice list as CSV._
AC-2. Given a user who currently sees a set of columns in the invoice list, when the user exports the invoice list, then the CSV file contains those columns. _The export contains the columns the user currently sees._

### Open questions
- [minor] Main path: Which invoices does the export contain when the invoice list is filtered? Main path: In what order do the columns appear in the export?

### Out of scope
None stated.
